question: A 21-year-old man is admitted to the intensive care unit for respiratory failure requiring mechanical ventilation. His minute ventilation is calculated to be 7.0 L/min, and his alveolar ventilation is calculated to be 5.1 L/min. Which of the following is most likely to decrease the difference between minute ventilation and alveolar ventilation?

options.opb: Increasing the partial pressure of inhaled oxygen
options.opd: Decreasing the affinity of hemoglobin for oxygen
